digest.component_or_area: CI gate steps in GitHub Actions workflows
propositions: Gate steps in _build-and-test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml run repo scripts without if-present guards, causing hard failures when scripts are absent from checked-out patchsets
Gerrit Verified lane takes workflow definition from target branch but checks out change tree, causing steps added on main to fail against changes whose base predates script availability
Nine unguarded steps in _build-and-test.yml and two in gerrit-verify.yaml golden-path job need conditional guards that skip gracefully with logging when scripts are missing
Each guarded gate step must still enforce its validation when the script is present, with no weakening of gate integrity
A structural lint check must prevent future instances by failing when patchset-lane workflow steps run repo scripts without if-present guards
